summary: Muhammad Ibtisam Tanveer is a frontend software engineer. He works at Smart Energy Pays in Berlin (since Feb 2025) building banking web products with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind. Previously he was a software engineer at Gigalabs in Lahore (Nov 2022–Sep 2024) on PIMdesk, Pushka Hub, and full-stack features with React, Next.js, NestJS, and Flask. He is pursuing an M.Sc. in Web Engineering at TU Chemnitz (2024–2026) and holds a B.Sc. in Computer Science from National University of Technology (NUTECH) in Islamabad (2018–2022).
